function: Channel estimation: a complex CNN refines the least-squares CSI estimate of an uplink ISAC link, which then serves AoA/range sensing and demodulation (pp. 4-5).
system: Uplink OFDM ISAC at 28 GHz; BS with 64-antenna ULA, single-antenna UE; L=2 paths; no RIS (p. 9).
method: Complex-valued ResNet-like CNN with FFT angle-delay transform modules; supervised training, MSE loss between enhanced and true CSI, input power-normalized (pp. 5-7).
data_channel: Own simulated multipath channel (Eq. 2) with random AoA, range, velocity; 2000 CSI items per SNR for training, independently generated test data (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained on dynamic-channel CSI (Nc=256, SNR 0-15 dB); tested on dynamic and static channels, also with Nc=128 and 512 (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, LMMSE, DFT transform-domain, PP-OMP; learned: dualCNN [22]; own CNN1/CNN2 ablations; MUSIC and FFT for range sensing (pp. 10-12).
metrics: CSI NMSE, BER for 16-QAM and 64-QAM, AoA estimation MSE, range estimation MSE (pp. 10-12).
complexity: Big-O analysis, O{P Nc[9(C1^2+C2^2)+2log2(P Nc)]+P^3}, compared with LS, LMMSE and PP-OMP; no runtime or parameter count (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 9: "we can generate the true CSI for the static channel according to Section II-B" (own multipath model of Eq. 2 on p. 4; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used or mentioned).
q2_support: p. 10: "trained by dynamic channel CSI data with Nc = 256 to enhance both the dynamic and static channel CSI data with various Nc" (Fig. 8, p. 11, shows Nc = 128, 256 and 512).
q3_support: p. 10: "compared with LS, LMMSE, the DFT-based transform-domain estimator [26], PP-OMP [24], the state-of-the-art dualCNN [22] CSI estimators" (NMSE in Fig. 7; BER against PP-OMP, dualCNN and LS in Figs. 9-12).
q4_support: p. 7: "the comprehensive complexity of the ISAC complex CNN CSI enhancer is O{P Nc [9(C1 2 + C2 2 ) + 2log2 (P Nc )] + P 3 }" (Section III-D, compared with LS, LMMSE and PP-OMP).
q5_support: p. 9: "The test data are generated using the above parameters independently" (own simulated data; no code or data link, DOI, public dataset or measured data is stated anywhere in the paper).
notes: Area 2 because the learned part is CSI estimation in an ISAC link; the AoA (MUSIC) and range (biased FFT) sensing steps are not learned. The BS has 64 antennas, so the system check passes. The NMSE values of LMMSE and dualCNN are referenced to [22] (p. 10). The static channel is a special case of the dynamic one (p. 9), so q2 rests on the test with other Nc than the training value 256.
